messages:
maria (docs): opened a small PR to clean up 429/timeouts snippets in the SDK area: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518
jonathan (eng-runtime): quick summary?
maria (docs): removed old header-based retry example (`x-rw-retry`), added unified pseudo-code + explicit exponential backoff+jitter. also added a short note distinguishing quota 429 vs congestion 429.
sam (eng-ml): can we add an async python semaphore example? people hit concurrency limits and the sync snippets are misleading.
alexa (devex): +1 — also add a Node example using AbortController so callers have a clear timeout pattern.
maria (docs): added async aiohttp snippet and a node fetch example with AbortController and a comment about using `AbortSignal.timeout()` on newer node.
john (eng-runtime): small suggestion: call out fallback behavior differences: quota 429 -> surface to caller; congestion 429 -> retry with jitter and optional model-fallback. one-liner is fine.
maria (docs): added the one-liner and linked to rate-limit runbook.
ci-bot: lint: failed  codeblock language mismatch at line 28
maria (docs): fixing now, converting codeblock markers and adjusting indent.
ci-bot: lint: passed; deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-518--docs.redwood.ai
jonathan (eng-runtime): skimmed preview, looking good. node snippet: prefer `AbortSignal.timeout()` over setTimeout if available, but note polyfill for older Node.
maria (docs): updated accordingly.
alexa (devex): I'll add a tiny unit-test example for the SDK that asserts backoff helper called with exponential schedule. keeping it 6 lines.
sam (eng-ml): for the embeddings fallback sample, include a comment about cost tradeoffs and eventual consistency.
maria (docs): added compact embeddings fallback example and a short cost note. plan: merge in 24h if no blockers. tagging for next patch release notes.
jonathan (eng-runtime): ack, if any Dedicated regressions surface ping me.
maria (docs): thanks all :thumbsup:
